title: Leveling: XP, stat points and skill points
summary: How much XP each level needs, how many stat and skill points you get, and how a party shares XP.

blocks.text: 3 per level up to level 30, 2 up to level 60, 1 up to level 100, none after. Rank bonus: +20 at rank S+, +30 at rank Nation. Every stat starts at 5 and caps at 999. Daily orders also give 5 stat points.

blocks.text: A party holds up to 4 awakened. The XP of a kill is not split : every member who counts gets his full solo XP for it, as if he had hit the monster, multiplied by a party bonus (×1 alone, ×1.1 for two, ×1.2 for three, ×1.3 for four). A member counts when he is within 150 studs of the monster or in the same dungeon, alive or dead for less than 10 s; the kill also counts for his daily orders.

blocks.text: A monster 3 or more ranks above you that you did not hit yourself gives ×0.25 (no boosting a low-rank friend); hit it once and you get your full share. A monster weaker than your rank gives −20% XP per rank of difference, as when you play alone. You never get less than what you would get alone.
